comments.text: One thing that everyone is overlooking regarding the tires and the turn of the wheels is the difference in response time between the electronic throttle, the engine response, and the mechanical steering linkage.  For the tires to spin before they turn, she had to hit the gas before starting the turn.  The throttle responds in microseconds, it takes a little time for the engine and transmission to respond, and it takes time for the steering input to translate into wheel movement.  The steering linkage will respond quicker than the engine and transmission.
